preset_screens.name: Earnings Streak
preset_screens.description: RS ≥ 80 · above 200-DMA · EPS ≥ 25% and sales ≥ 20% in EACH of the last two quarters · ≥ Rs 7 Cr/day. Walk-forward on 20 weekly snapshots (Jun-Oct 2026): +2.4pp 20-session edge vs +1.0pp for RS ≥ 80 alone (descriptive, one 5-month window)

preset_screens.name: Earnings Streak · P1
preset_screens.description: Earnings Streak, cleanest tier: EPS Rating ≥ 90 · EPS growth ≥ 50% both quarters · less than 60% above the 200-DMA (stretched names lost ≥ 10% in 21.7% of cases vs 11.1% when < 30% above)

preset_screens.name: RS 97+ at Highs
preset_screens.description: RS ≥ 97 · within 5% of the 52-week high · market cap ≥ ₹1,000 Cr · ≥ ₹7 Cr/day traded. Pattern study (107 MSI snapshots, Jun-Nov 2026): with these floors the 20-session edge vs the same-day median is only +1.6pp (early +2.0 / late +0.7, win 56%, 328 obs / 73 stocks); the headline +5.1pp sits in thin small caps the floors exclude. Descriptive, one 5-month window; not a Tier 1 check (EPS Rating not required)
